name: 0000-MAIN
description: This paragraph serves as the main entry point for the program, coordinating setup, transaction processing, and cleanup operations.

algorithm.details: Calls 2000-PROCESS-TXNS in a loop to handle individual transactions.
Calls 3000-CLOSE-FILES to finalize and release resources.
Outputs status messages to the screen.
Executes a GOBACK to signal end of processing.

sideEffects.description: Operations performed within 1000-OPEN-FILES and 3000-CLOSE-FILES may involve writing to or modifying files.
